children: Priyanka Nayak joins HDFC ERGO after four years at Bain, bringing over 15 years of experience across talent, learning and employee experience

HDFC ERGO General Insurance has appointed Priyanka Nayak as Vice President – Human Resources, Talent Strategy and Employer Brand. She moves to the role after more than four years at Bain & Company, where she was Senior Manager, Human Resources and led learning and talent initiatives for India offices.

Nayak brings over 15 years of experience across talent management, learning and development, employee experience, organisational capability building and HR. Her career includes roles at Bain & Company, Nium, Boston Consulting Group (BCG) and Capgemini.

Nayak's current role covers enterprise talent strategy, employer branding and internal communications. Her responsibilities include work related to the employee proposition, organisational culture and talent priorities.
She joined HDFC ERGO in July 2026 and is based in Mumbai. The appointment expands her career from specialist learning and talent roles into a broader HR leadership position.
Before joining HDFC ERGO, Nayak spent four and a half years at Bain & Company, serving as Senior Manager, Human Resources from January 2022 to June 2026.

During her tenure, she led learning and talent initiatives for Bain's India offices across consulting and business support teams. Her work covered capability building and talent-related programmes across the organisation.

Earlier, Nayak was Manager, Employee Experience & Learning at Nium from June 2019 to December 2021. She worked on employee experience, learning and engagement initiatives across teams and geographies.
She previously spent more than two years at BCG as Senior Specialist, Learning & Development, where she managed leadership and learning initiatives for consulting teams in India.

Nayak began her career in the learning and HR function at Capgemini, where she worked from October 2012 to January 2017. Her earlier experience also includes roles with XL Dynamics India and Info Edge India.

Nayak's career has largely focused on learning, talent and employee experience, with increasing responsibility across HR strategy and capability building. Her move to HDFC ERGO brings these areas into a wider enterprise HR remit covering talent strategy and employer brand.
She holds a Master of Human Resource Development and Management from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies and a Bachelor of Commerce degree from SIES, Sion.
